thread:
maria: Heads-up — ACME (prod) is seeing streaming SSE sessions drop after about ~65s of inactivity. They get a partial last chunk, client reconnects, and we see duplicate billing for the reconnect. Ticket C-4982 https://redwood.tickets/4982

David: Can you paste the runtime logs and a minimal repro? Is this only via Cloudflare in front of ALB?

maria: Quick tail from the customer run (sanitized):
```
2026-02-12T09:12:22Z runtime: open stream id=0 req=abc123
2026-02-12T09:13:27Z runtime: write chunk id=0 size=512
2026-02-12T09:13:27Z runtime: client half_close id=0
2026-02-12T09:13:27Z runtime: write failed: broken pipe (errno 32)
2026-02-12T09:13:28Z runtime: connection reset by peer
```
They're on Cloudflare (Full) -> ALB -> origin nginx -> runtime. Default ALB idle timeout at the moment is 60s (we think).

ashok: Two likely vectors: (1) ALB/L7 handoff/keepalive mismatch where ALB reuses backend sockets and a half-closed connection gets RST when origin probes; (2) Cloudflare HTTP/2 -> origin HTTP/1 conversion and downstream buffering/aggregation. The ~65s time fits an idle timeout + a small jitter.

lin: Customer says they only see it when they sit idle and then send a follow-up prompt. If they stream continuously no problem.

maria: Minimal repro we used against their stack:
```
# open an SSE stream, then wait > 60s, then send another event
curl -N -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  --http1.1 "https://acme.example.com/v1/streams?request_id=abc123"
```
After ~65s connection closes and client gets truncated last chunk.

David: Can we capture tcpdump when reproducing? Suggested filters:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <client-ip> and port 443 -w sse-handshake.pcap
# or origin side
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <alb-ip> and port <origin-port> -w origin-side.pcap
```
Look for FIN/RST around the idle mark and whether it's the ALB or origin initiating.

ashok: Quick header hints customers can try: add `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no` on the upstream to discourage buffering. If using nginx -> ensure `proxy_buffering off; proxy_ignore_client_abort on;` for the SSE location.

maria: Customer tried `X-Accel-Buffering: no` and it reduced frequency but didn't eliminate it. They are on CF Pro with HTTP/2 to the edge.

David: Short-term mitigation we should recommend to customers:
- Increase ALB idle timeout to > 300s (ideally 350) so LB doesn't close idle backend sockets.
- Turn off Cloudflare origin HTTP/2 (set Origin HTTP/2 to Off) to avoid HTTP/2->1.1 conversion buffering in some configs.
- Ensure proxy buffering is disabled at intermediate nginx/Envoy (proxy_buffering off / disable http2 to origin).
- Add a lightweight heartbeat from client/runtime every 15-20s (SSE comment `:\n` or tiny whitespace) to keep connection alive.

ashok: Long-term runtime fix: we're going to add periodic SSE comments (configurable) from the runtime by default for hosted customers — 20s heartbeat until customer opts out. That should reduce reliance on external LB timeouts. Also adding a request-id idempotency token for billing de-dupe on reconnected streams.

maria: Billing note — customer is being charged twice because reconnects open a new request_id in their client. Support will tell them to send a stable `X-Request-ID` header for reconnects. I also opened a billing follow-up to dedupe on our side when same request-id appears within 5m.

lin: Action items:
- ashok: plan ETA for heartbeat + de-dupe token (runtime) — please post design doc.
- david: help write a KB article with ALB/Cloudflare/NGINX config examples and tcpdump triage steps.
- maria: share repro pcap and the customer's ALB/CF config in the ticket.
- billing: investigate duplicate charge mitigation via request-id dedupe.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for runtime-keepalive-heartbeat feature branch — staging rollout when tests pass.

David: Quick troubleshooting checklist to send the customer now: short list they can action immediately:
1) Add `X-Accel-Buffering: no` (nginx) or `proxy_buffering off` (Envoy) on the SSE route.
2) Set ALB idle timeout to >= 300s.
3) If on Cloudflare, disable Origin HTTP/2 or enable "no-transform" rules.
4) Make client send a 15s comment heartbeat (`:heartbeat\n\n`).

maria: I'll send that checklist and capture the pcap. Will update ticket C-4982 once we have pcap + origin logs. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
